setting: You are at a gym between sets. Aria is training nearby. Ask to share the equipment, or start a short, respectful conversation about the workout. Keep it light.
sceneNote: Adults only. Respectful practice. No sexual content, no pressure, no appearance ratings, no contact details, no private meetups. Aria is another adult at the gym. Friendly, not a date. No comments about bodies.

open_good.speaker: aria
open_good.text: Hey. I have one set left. Want to work in?

open_flat.speaker: aria
open_flat.text: Hi. Did you need the rack, or were you saying hello?

context.speaker: aria
context.text: Same program problem. I keep the rests honest or the last sets fall apart.

question.speaker: aria
question.text: I like that question. I am just trying to leave stronger than I arrived. You?

humor.speaker: aria
humor.text: Ha. Yes. Confidence in here is mostly just showing up again.

intro.speaker: aria
intro.text: Nice to meet you. I am Aria. I train early so the rest of the day stays mine.

inclusive.speaker: aria
inclusive.text: Thanks for asking instead of hovering. The rack is yours after this set.

pushy.speaker: aria
pushy.text: That is not a gym conversation I want. I am going back to my set.

neutral.speaker: aria
neutral.text: All good. A simple hello works in here.

exit.speaker: aria
exit.text: Nice talking. Have a good session. I will leave the rack how I found it.

timeout.speaker: aria
timeout.text: I should finish this set. Good luck with the workout.

rubric.label: Clear opener
rubric.tip: Start with a calm hello and your point.

rubric.label: Used the real situation
rubric.tip: Name the thing in front of you, not a generic line.

rubric.label: Asked a real question
rubric.tip: Ask one open question so they can answer.

rubric.label: Said who you are
rubric.tip: One short line about who you are is enough.

rubric.label: Easy tone
rubric.tip: A little warmth beats a stiff speech.

rubric.label: Left room for them
rubric.tip: Invite their view instead of talking over them.

rubric.label: Clean close
rubric.tip: End with thanks and a next step.

penalties.label: Pushy or personal remark
penalties.tip: Drop pressure. Stay on the topic and their comfort.
